checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object is clearly spherical and proportional to a standard baseball.

artifact_observations.location: Upper-left quadrant of the baseball surface
artifact_observations.reasoning: A sharp, dark linear indentation or crack runs across the leather surface. This is not a standard feature of a baseball and looks like a generation error or physical damage not consistent with the rest of the pristine ball.
The red threads do not have clear boundaries where they cross the white leather; they appear to bleed or melt into the surface. Individual stitches lack distinct separation and uniform thickness.
The black object behind the ball lacks coherent structure. It is amorphous and blurry, failing to resolve into recognizable fingers or padding of a baseball glove. It looks like a melted mass.
